text:
ari: tiny personal update — accepted the promo to Senior Staff Engineer today 🎈 and also closed on a tiny fixer-upper! housewarming + low-key celebration in the kitchen on Wed 4:30pm. nothing formal, just snacks and a few minutes if you wanna swing by.

tess: HUGE congrats ari!! :tada: when's the housewarming party? need address?

ari: thanks!! just in-office for now (short on time). planning to bring a sheet cake and some thai takeout. also doing a small 'no-physical-gifts' ask: donations to Books for All or plant recs for the new place. i'll post the link.

felix: congrats!! can we do a 15-min toast? i can bring candles and maybe a little playlist. also vote on cake: chocolate or lemon?

marta: lemon pls. also i'm bringing a small spider plant. low maintenance.

people-ops: Ari congrats! People Ops will cover cake (vegan option included). i'll create a brief invite and add an RSVP. also noted the donation link for the invite description. thanks for flagging the clean-up request.

ari: appreciated jen — oh wait i'm ari, but yes, ty folks. :)

facilities-bot: Facilities note: Quiet cleanup requested. Disposable confetti not allowed; please use paper streamers only. Cleaning crew scheduled Thu 9:00 AM.

felix: haha noted. no confetti cannons. maybe biodegradable streamers?

tess: can we do a tiny poll here for cake + music? react with :chocolate_bar: for chocolate, :lemon: for lemon; react :headphones: for mellow playlist, :guitar: for upbeat.

marta: reacted :lemon: :headphones:

ari: poll results so far: lemon + mellow. love it.

calendar-bot: Event created "Ari: Promo + Housewarming (kitchen)" Wed 4:30 PM - 5:00 PM. Invite sent by people-ops.

ari: if you can't make it but want to drop a plant rec or the Books for All link, DM me or paste here. big thanks everyone 1; feels surreal to celebrate two milestones at once.

people-ops: invite up and includes donation link and vegan cake note. see you all on Wed!
